name: WatchSync
overview: Sync watch history between libraries of different qualities (4K/HD)
description: Automatically synchronizes watch history between libraries of different qualities (4K/HD). When a movie is watched in 4K, the HD version is also marked as watched (and vice versa). Uses IMDB, TMDB and TVDB identifiers to match media between libraries.

versions.changelog: Initial release with automatic sync and scheduled task

name: JellyTag
overview: Overlays quality badges (resolution, HDR, codec, audio, language) and age ratings (German FSK) on media posters and thumbnails
description: JellyTag automatically overlays quality badges on your media posters and thumbnails. Supports resolution, HDR, video codec, audio, language flags, and VOST indicator. Also overlays official German FSK age-rating labels (0/6/12/16/18) read from each item's content rating. Badges are rendered server-side and visible on all Jellyfin clients. Features per-panel configuration, SVG and text badge styles, custom badge upload, live preview, and library filtering.

versions.changelog: New: Age rating (Altersfreigabe) badge panel with the official German FSK labels (0/6/12/16/18) read from the item's content rating, inheriting from the series for episodes. New FSK label SVG assets (current Dec 2008 design) from Wikimedia Commons. New 'Age Rating Badges (FSK)' config panel; old configs auto-normalised.
Fix: exclude SkiaSharp native assets that caused plugin loading crash, pin Jellyfin packages to 10.11.0 for full 10.11.x compatibility
Fix: support Jellyfin base URL configuration, fix resolution detection thresholds
v2: Multi-category badges (resolution, HDR, codec, audio, language, VOST), per-panel config, SVG rendering with SkiaSharp, custom badge upload, live preview, library filtering, config export/import
Initial release with quality detection, configurable badges, and image caching
